quandoUsar: Related views of the same object, such as Overview, Activity, Members, and Billing of a project.
Settings sections where people look at one at a time and the rest of the page stays the same.
Many tabs in a narrow space: the list scrolls sideways, with fading at the edges and scroll buttons.
quandoEvitar: Use `segmented-control` when the switch is a mode or filter without its own content panel.
Use `accordion` when people need to read several sections in sequence, as on a long page on a phone.
Use `stepper` for steps in order that people go through once.

teclado.acao: Enters the list at the active tab and, from there, goes to the panel.
Move focus to the previous or next tab and activate it right away, wrapping to the first after the last.
Go to the first or last tab.

acessibilidade: Built on the Radix Tabs: `tablist`, tabs with `aria-selected` and `aria-controls`, `tabpanel` panels that are focusable and tied to the tab, and a roving `tabindex` for focus.
Pass `aria-label` to `TabsList` to name the set; the scroll buttons are named “Scroll tabs left” and “Scroll tabs right”, fixed in English in the code.
The panel that leaves is `inert` while it fades, receiving neither clicks nor focus.
movimento: The active tab's highlight slides to the new tab on a no-overshoot spring, always within the same `Tabs`.
The new panel enters 8 px from the side of the chosen tab, the old one leaves quickly toward the other side, and the height goes from the previous to the new on a no-overshoot spring.
With “reduce motion” on, the highlight jumps, the panels only fade in place, the height does not animate, and the list scrolling is instant.
responsivo: When the tabs do not fit, the list scrolls sideways with fading at the edges and arrow buttons, and the active or focused tab is brought into view.
notasIA: Pass `defaultValue`, or `value` with `onValueChange`; without them no tab starts selected and no panel appears.
Inactive panels are unmounted and lose their internal state; with `forceMount` they stay mounted, but also visible, so hide the inactive one through `data-state="inactive"`.
Assemble `Tabs`, `TabsList` with one `TabsTrigger` per tab, and a `TabsContent` with the same `value` as each tab. Import from `@/components/ryan-ui/tabs/tabs`.
